headline: The United Arab Emirates and the United States held talks on closer cooperation in AI, quantum technology and space, Fast Company Middle East reports.

summary: Fast Company Middle East reported on 7 Oct 2026 that the United Arab Emirates and the United States held talks to deepen their ties in AI, quantum technology and space, building, its subtitle says, on a $1.4 trillion technology partnership.
